Description

Distribution Transformation - Change Management Lead

Are you a transformational leader with a passion for shaping the future of retail banking? As Citizens reimagines its distribution model through the Network Evolution and Xperience Transformation (NEXT) initiative, we are seeking a senior change leader to accelerate enterprise transformation, drive adoption of new operating models, and influence lasting behavioral and cultural change across our branch-centric ecosystem.

Our transformation requires leaders who can translate strategy into execution, mobilize organizations to successfully change behavior, and create the conditions for sustained transformation.

Position Overview
The Distribution Transformation Change Management Lead serves as a strategic partner to business leadership, transformation teams, and field leaders, driving enterprise-scale adoption of key retail transformation initiatives. The role is accountable for developing and executing integrated change strategies that enable successful implementation of future-state distribution models, operating cadences, leadership routines and customer engagement practices.

Beyond traditional change management, this leader will shape organizational readiness, influence transformation design decisions, and drive measurable behavior change throughout the distribution network. The role requires deep expertise in organizational transformation, operating model activation, leadership engagement, and change analytics, coupled with the ability to influence senior stakeholders as well as front line colleagues, and align diverse teams around a shared vision. This role serves as enterprise lead for change management across the Distribution transformation and may directly lead internal and external change resources.

The successful candidate will establish the frameworks, governance, and measurement disciplines necessary to ensure transformation outcomes are realized and sustained, serving as a key steward of Citizens' modernization journey.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Transformation Leadership

• Lead enterprise change strategy for high-impact distribution transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment between business objectives, organizational readiness, and field execution.
• Partner with executive sponsors and transformation leaders to identify adoption risks, organizational dependencies, and cultural barriers that could impede successful transformation.
• Partner with HR, Talent and Business leaders to assess organizational impacts, role evolution and capability requirements associated with transformation initiatives.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to other leaders on change readiness, workforce impacts, stakeholder engagement, and transformation effectiveness.
• Influence transformation design decisions by representing colleague, customer, and field perspectives throughout program planning and execution.

Organizational Adoption & Operating Model Activation

• Translate future-state distribution and operating model strategies into comprehensive adoption roadmaps spanning organizational structure, roles and capabilities.
• Design and implement scalable approaches that drive adoption, proficiency, and sustainment across a geographically dispersed retail organization.
• Ensure new ways of working are embedded into daily operations, leadership routines, talent processes, and performance expectations.

Leadership & Stakeholder Mobilization

• Partner with distribution leadership teams to build visible sponsorship, accountability, and ownership of transformation outcomes.
• Establish leadership activation strategies that equip leaders to model desired behaviors and reinforce transformation objectives.
• Build alignment among cross-functional stakeholders, fostering shared ownership for adoption and business outcomes.

Innovation, Experimentation & Continuous Improvement

• Lead test-and-learn methodologies, including micro-testing and pilots, to accelerate adoption and reduce implementation risk.
• Establish mechanisms for continuous listening, feedback collection, and organizational sensing to inform real-time adjustments to transformation strategies.
• Drive a culture of learning and agility by incorporating field insights into transformation design and execution.

Measurement & Value Realization

• Define and oversee a comprehensive change measurement framework, including organizational readiness, adoption, behavioral, proficiency, and business outcome metrics.
• Partner with Data and Analytics teams to quantify adoption trends, identify gaps, and proactively address areas of resistance.
• Monitor progress against transformation objectives and provide executive-level reporting and recommendations to ensure successful value realization.

Sustainment & Culture Transformation

• Develop long-term sustainment strategies that reinforce behavioral shifts and ensure enduring business impact beyond formal transformation programs.
• Champion cultural evolution efforts that strengthen adaptability, accountability, collaboration, and customer-centric behaviors across the distribution network.
• Establish governance mechanisms that support continued optimization and evolution of transformed operating models.

Qualifications - Required

• 10+ years of experience leading large-scale organizational transformation, change management, operating model activation, or business transformation initiatives.
• Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to drive enterprise-wide adoption of strategic business initiatives.
• Significant experience leading organizational and behavioral change across complex, multi-location, customer-facing organizations and customer-facing colleagues.
• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.
• Experience establishing change measurement frameworks that connect adoption outcomes to business performance.
• Strong executive communication, facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

• Experience within retail banking or distribution organizations, or experience within deep customer experience industries.
• Experience supporting branch network transformation, workforce transformation, or distribution strategy initiatives.
• Demonstrated expertise in behavioral science, adoption strategy, design thinking, continuous improvement, or test-and-learn methodologies.
• Advanced degree in Business, Organizational Development, Psychology, Change Leadership, or a related field

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $152,000-$200,050 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits

Some job boards have started using jobseeker-reported data to estimate salary ranges for roles. If you apply and qualify for this role, a recruiter will discuss accurate pay guidance.

The senior detection engineer is part of the larger detection engineering team that creates, tunes, maintains, and improves the detection lifecycle. This hands-on role is at the forefront of agentic detection engineering of a rapidly maturing security function. You’ll work closely with our data pipelines team, incident response, insider risk, and threat intelligence teams to make the most effective detection content to detect threats as quickly as possible.

Detection at DoorDash spans more than the corporate estate. You’ll build coverage across cloud infrastructure, corporate endpoints and identity, and the marketplace itself - where consumer, merchant, and Dasher platforms create abuse and insider-risk patterns you won’t find in a typical enterprise SOC. • 7+ years of experience in secure coding, alert development, and detection engineering.

jobs.description: The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) team at Amazon Ads is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that help tens of millions of advertisers understand the value of their ad spend while prioritizing customer privacy and measurement quality. The Media Planning Science team, part of broader MADS team, develops and implements models that deliver insights and recommendations for strategic media planning and measurement across Amazon Advertising's product portfolio. Our mission is to help advertisers create and execute plans that meet their objectives while providing accurate measurement tools. We work on a multitude of problem statements that encompass Reach and Frequency, Budget Planning Optimization, and Recommendations. Our models leverage both heuristic and machine learning approaches including deep learning techniques, with insights delivered through agent-based tools and APIs that integrate seamlessly into user interfaces and programmatic systems to ensure optimal advertising outcomes. As a Senior Applied Scientist on the team, you will be at the forefront of innovation, developing media planning solutions end-to-end from inception to production. You will set the technical vision and innovate on behalf of our customers. You will propose, design, analyze, and productionize models to provide novel measurement insights to our customers. You will partner with engineering to deploy these solutions into production. You will work with key stakeholders from various business teams to enable advertisers to act upon those metrics. Key job responsibilities * Lead the development of media planning models and solutions that address the full spectrum of an advertiser's investment, focusing on scalable and efficient methodologies. * Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and business teams to define and implement measurement solutions. * Use state-of-the-art scientific technologies including Generative AI, Classical Machine Learning, Causal Inference, Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision to develop state of the art models that measure the impact of media plans across different metrics. * Drive experimentation and the continuous improvement of ML models through iterative development, testing, and optimization. * Translate complex scientific challenges into clear and impactful solutions for business stakeholders. * Mentor and guide junior scientists, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture. * Foster collaborations between scientists to move faster, with broader impact. * Regularly engage with the broader scientific community with presentations, publications, and patents. A day in the life You will solve real-world problems by analyzing large amounts of data, generate business insights and opportunities, design simulations and experiments, and develop ML/DL models. The team is driven by business needs, which requires collaboration with other Scientists, Engineers, and Product Managers across the advertising organization. You will prepare written and verbal documents to share insights to audiences of varying levels of technical sophistication. About the team We are a team of scientists across Applied, Research, and Data Science disciplines. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, DL, NLP, Gen AI, and Causal Inference with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, sales leaders, and other scientists with expertise in the ads industry and on building scalable modeling and software solutions.

The Program Management and Coordination team within AWS Infrastructure Services is growing to support an expanding portfolio of data centre sites across Asia-Pacific, and we are looking for a Controls Coordinator to own the transactional backbone of controls delivery across APAC. You will manage every work order, change order, purchase request, purchase order, and capital appropriation request end to end against published SLAs, partnering with Controls Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Procurement to turn engineering decisions into committed spend. The timing matters. The team is part-way through automating its own transactional work, so you will help design that tooling rather than inherit it finished. Vendor management is also becoming a defined programme rather than something each coordinator handles independently, giving you a clear area to own from the start. No data centre experience is needed. What matters is what you do with a process once you hold it: writing the run book a new joiner can follow without asking, building the report that answers the question before it gets asked, and automating the parts that should never have been manual. Key job responsibilities - Manage every work order, change order, purchase request, purchase order, and capital appropriation request end to end, tracking each against its published SLA and escalating exceptions early with a recommendation attached. - Coordinate with Controls Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Procurement across APAC to land commitments that carry real money, including support for annual and mid-year operating plans. - Design and maintain run books and process documentation so that workflows survive your absence and can be followed by any team member without additional guidance. - Build reporting and automation that removes routine processing from people, using AI tools where they add value, and measure the before-and-after impact of every improvement you deliver. - Own the vendor management programme for your region, defining consistent processes and partnering with global counterparts across a follow-the-sun operating model. A day in the life Your morning starts with your queue: the requests are yours from day one, and so are the blockers behind them. You might spend the first hour clearing purchase orders through their approval chain, then shift to refining an automation that shaves a manual step off the change-order workflow. After a standup with your Controls Engineering partners, you review an open vendor issue with Procurement and draft the escalation note. Later you pull together the data for a business review that senior leadership will read directly. Between tasks you are testing a new AI-driven dashboard the team is building in-house. By the end of the day you have moved work forward, removed a friction point, and documented what you changed so the next person does not have to ask. About the team The Program Management and Coordination team is the governance group within AWS Infrastructure Services that owns the planning cycles, goals, business reviews, and mechanisms the APAC region runs on. This is where process gets designed rather than requested. The team is eight people today, spread across Tokyo, Singapore, Sydney, and Melbourne, and everyone sits within the same Tech Ops Engineering job family — meaning the step from coordinator to programme manager is a genuine progression on a single ladder. Our closest partners are the Controls Engineers running deployments, projects, service, and colocation across APAC, along with Finance, Legal, and Procurement on every commitment that carries money. We also collaborate with our counterparts in the Americas and EMEA through a global follow-the-sun model, so a process you improve once is improved everywhere we operate.

Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Polish financial institutions — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

[Foundation Model R&D]

Foundation Model Research 실은 AI Research 본부의 비전을 바탕으로 Multimodal LLM, World Model 등 Foundation Model 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여, 새로운 플레이 경험을 만드는 데 기여합니다.

AI Research 본부는 다양한 전문성을 가진 구성원들이 함께 문제를 정의하고 해결하는 조직입니다. 연구자, 엔지니어 등 여러 분야의 팀원들과 협업하며, 직급이나 연차와 무관하게 기술적 근거에 기반한 의견 개진이 장려됩니다.

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Architect with a strong AI and agent-integration focus to lead the design, proof-of-concept (POC), and hands-on implementation of identity patterns for AI workloads, conversational agents, and AI platform integrations across the enterprise. The ideal candidate combines deep IAM architecture expertise with practical engineering skills—building POCs, configuring OAuth/OIDC flows, and partnering directly with AI engineering teams to secure agent runtimes, tool access, and human-in-the-loop experiences.

This role owns IAM architecture for AI use cases, including delegated and service-to-service access, API gateway/BFF token flows, scoped credentials, and governance alignment. You will design and validate OAuth/OIDC patterns (Auth Code + PKCE, OBO, token exchange, client credentials) across identity providers (PingOne AIC, Entra ID), gateways, and agent platforms. The AI IAM Architect partners across AI/platform engineering, IAM, security, and enterprise architecture to define reusable, secure, and production-ready identity standards for agents.

Key Responsibilities:

• Discover AI/agent identity requirements across users, services, runtimes, tools, and APIs.
• Assess existing SSO, MFA, federation, and API authorization models; identify gaps in delegation, token lifecycle, scopes, secrets, and auditability.
• Design enterprise IAM patterns (user context propagation, delegation chains, BFF sessions, least-privilege access) and OAuth/OIDC client models.
• Define standards for securing agent tools, data access, and cross-domain integrations; align to zero trust and regulatory controls.
• Produce architecture artifacts (CAD/HLD/PSS) and reference implementations.
• Lead and build IAM POCs (end-to-end flows, token exchange, gateway enforcement, delegated agent access).
• Configure/test identity flows; troubleshoot tokens, scopes, and integrations.
• Implement or guide IAM integrations across gateways, BFFs, agent orchestration, and observability.
• Evaluate and implement scalable Non-Human Identity (NHI) and secrets management solutions for agents and autonomous workloads, including credential issuance, rotation, and revocation.
• Design and implement agent identity at the gateway, including token validation, scope enforcement, and policy-driven access control.
• Automate agent onboarding workflows, including identity registration, entitlement assignment, and integration with IAM/PAM platforms.
• Define entitlement and data enforcement patterns to ensure agents access only authorized tools, APIs, and datasets.
• Ensure production-scale reliability, observability, and operational readiness for agent identity services.
• Design and test MCP-enabled identity integration flows for agent tools and external access.
• Enable secure external developer, agent, and MCP access through federation, scoped credentials, and gateway controls.
• Transition validated patterns to IAM engineering for production rollout.
• Define agent identity lifecycle (registration, credential rotation, revocation, environment separation).
• Integrate IAM across AI platform components; support CI/CD and IaC for IAM configurations.
• Establish patterns for human-in-the-loop controls, break-glass access, and rate limiting.
• Maintain documentation, decision records, diagrams, and runbooks.
• Deliver POC summaries, evaluations, and implementation guidance; communicate risks and dependencies.
• Ensure regulatory compliance; partner on threat modeling and controls (secrets, PAM, audit evidence).
• Serve as IAM SME for AI initiatives; mentor engineers.
• Deliver production-ready IAM patterns and reduce identity risk across AI workloads.

Requirements:

• 6+ years in IAM, security architecture, or platform engineering with significant IAM scope.
• 2+ years building IAM POCs and troubleshooting OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows (Auth Code + PKCE, refresh tokens, client credentials, token exchange, OBO).
• 2+ years with PingOne AIC and/or Microsoft Entra ID.

Core Competencies:

• Hands-on experience designing identity for APIs, microservices, and BFF architectures.
• Experience integrating IAM with API gateways, AI/ML platforms, and modern application stacks.
• Strong knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OIDC, JWT, scopes, and authorization patterns.
• Familiarity with agent/tool identity models and secure integration patterns.
• Ability to translate AI requirements into secure identity designs; strong communication skills.

Preferences:

• Experience delivering AI/ML agents or copilots to production.
• Experience with SailPoint, CyberArk/Delinea, or Auth0/CIAM.
• Experience with one or more NHI or secrets-management solutions, such as Oasis Security, Astrix Security, Entro Security, Akeyless, CyberArk/Conjur, or HashiCorp Vault.
• Knowledge of AI-aware API gateways (e.g., Kong).
• Experience with IAM modernization or M&A programs.
• Relevant certifications (CISSP, CCSP, Entra, Ping, SailPoint, AWS).
• Familiarity with zero trust and identity threat detection.

About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team turns research breakthroughs into production-grade systems. We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships.

About the Role

As a Deployment Lead (DL), you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.

This role is based in Tokyo. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance.

In this role, you will:

- Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent workstreams. Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

- Run day-to-day engineering execution. Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

- Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan. Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management.

- Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research workstreams land in time to support deployment goals.

- Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

- Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership.

- Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

- Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

- Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

- Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognise broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

- Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

- Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

- You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

- Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25-50%, sometimes higher).

- Have expertise in at least one major sector (e.g., healthcare, energy, financial services, semiconductors, IT) to elevate solution framing and credibility.

About the Team

OpenAI is building the infrastructure foundation for the next generation of AI. The Data Center Engineering team defines the strategy, reference architectures, technical requirements, and delivery standards for the large-scale data centers that support OpenAI research, products, and infrastructure partners.

As a Data Center Controls Network Engineer, you will design, validate, and scale the controls and OT network architectures that support high-density AI data centers. You will work across controls systems, OT infrastructure, telemetry, commissioning, deployment, and operations, partnering with mechanical, electrical, IT/networking, security, and external delivery teams.

About the Role

We are seeking a mid to senior OT Network Engineer with a strong controls systems background to lead the design and operation of resilient, secure, and scalable OT network architectures for high-density AI data centers. This role translates compute, power, cooling, and operational requirements into practical OT network designs, evaluates vendor solutions, and drives technical decisions across controls infrastructure, telemetry, commissioning, and operations.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in mission-critical OT environments, including industrial networking, virtualized infrastructure, and OT network operations, with expertise in routing, switching, segmentation, firewall policy, time synchronization, monitoring, and network lifecycle support.

Key Responsibilities

- Define controls, automation, and OT network requirements for AI data center campuses.

- Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, and reusable design templates.

- Review and develop basis-of-design and functional design documents, including OT network diagrams, IP/VLAN schemes, telemetry architectures, data flow diagrams, and commissioning requirements.

- Design OT and infrastructure network architectures, including physical topology, logical topology, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, routing, switching, redundancy, segmentation, firewall policy coordination, out-of-band management, monitoring, and remote access patterns.

- Develop day-two network operations requirements, including change management, configuration backups, golden configurations, monitoring thresholds, firmware lifecycle, rollback plans, and post-change validation.

- Partner with electrical, mechanical, IT/networking, security, and operations teams to ensure OT network systems align with GPU deployments, campus-wide telemetry, and failure-domain isolation requirements.

- Define integration patterns and protocol requirements across BACnet/IP, BACnet MSTP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, IEC-61850 MMS/GOOSE, MQTT, SNMP, syslog, NTP/PTP, IRIG-B, and vendor-specific interfaces.

- Lead technical evaluation of controls integrators, network equipment suppliers, design consultants, contractors, and commissioning agents

- Review network equipment submittals, configurations, firmware assumptions, certifications, test reports, and quality documentation.

- Support factory witnessed testing (FWT), site acceptance testing, network readiness checks, failover testing, and integrated systems testing.

- Troubleshoot complex controls network issues including packet loss, latency, duplicate IPs, routing errors, firewall drops, protocol incompatibilities, time synchronization drift, and intermittent device communication failures.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of relevant experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, OT networking, mission-critical facilities, or similar critical infrastructure environments.

- Strong expertise in resilient OT network architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support.

- Experience with OT/IT boundary design, secure enterprise integration, firewall policy design, redundant topologies, out-of-band management, and monitoring.

- Hands-on experience with Layer 3 OT network design, including IP addressing, subnetting, routing, VRFs, ACLs, inter-VLAN traffic control, and network segmentation.

- Hands-on experience with Layer 2 security and switching controls, including MACsec, port security, loop prevention, and switch-level access control.

- Hands-on experience in designing resilient OT network topologies using industrial redundancy protocols and architectures such as PRP, HSR, Cisco REP, RSTP/MSTP, and ring or star topologies.

- Hands-on experience in designing resilient infrastructure network architectures using HSRP/VRRP, spine-leaf topologies, redundant uplinks, and failure-domain isolation.

- Hands-on experience with industrial and infrastructure network equipment such as Cisco switches/routers, Juniper switches/routers, Palo Alto firewalls, Rockwell Automation Stratix switches, Siemens Ruggedcom or comparable industrial networking platforms.

- Experience with network management and observability platforms such as Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center), Palo Alto Panorama, Juniper Mist, industrial NMS tools, packet brokers, and OT monitoring platforms.

- Experience reviewing and producing technical design documentation, commissioning plans, and acceptance test procedures.

- Experience with factory witnessed testing, site acceptance testing, failover testing, telemetry validation, protocol compatibility testing, and root-cause analysis.

- Ability to use logs, packet captures, and field observations to make sound technical decisions and communicate risk clearly.

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred Skills

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Experience leading multi-campus OT network integration, commissioning, and operations across cross-functional teams, contractors, vendors, and delivery partners.

- Relevant networking certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, or similar networking credentials.

- Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, CompTIA Security+, or similar cybersecurity credentials are a plus.

- Experience with network automation, Git-based configuration management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, or similar to support scalable OT network deployment and lifecycle management.

- Experience with scripting, APIs, and automation workflows that improve OT network operations.

- Experience with relational database systems such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, or similar platforms used for OT telemetry, historian integrations, troubleshooting, and reporting.

jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/ea3769d7-8b54-4c91-8356-1b1608f50528/archer%20bow.jpeg]

WE ARE LOOKING FOR AN EXCEPTIONAL LEADER TO BUILD AND LEAD ONE OF THE MOST CRITICAL NEW TEAMS IN TITAN: STUDIO TOOLS.

TITAN IS SUPERCELL'S PROPRIETARY GAME ENGINE, THE IN-HOUSE TECHNOLOGY THAT POWERS EVERY GAME WE MAKE, REACHING 300 MILLION PLAYERS A MONTH. TITAN IS ALSO THE NAME OF THE ROUGHLY 70-PERSON ORGANIZATION BEHIND IT.

Studio Tools brings together Titan's Editor and Art Pipelines teams under a single charter: owning everything a game team touches when making games with Titan on the client and tooling side. That means the editor, all central tooling, and the full art pipelines.

This is a visionary role. We want to build tooling that Supercell's game teams, live and new, genuinely want to use because it gives them a real edge, not tooling they tolerate, but tooling they want to depend on. We need someone entrepreneurial enough to define what world-class looks like, and capable of leading the effort to build it.

This article https://supr.cl/game-engine-called-titan-jd explains why you've probably never heard of Titan. If you want a more technical read, this one https://supr.cl/game-engine-brawl-break-jd covers how Titan made Brawl Stars toilet break friendly.

Note: Internally your title will be Studio Tools Lead

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the vision and strategy for Studio Tools team: define what Supercell's editor and tooling suite should become, and build the clarity needed to get there.

- Define the golden path: what the ideal, yet pragmatic editor experience looks like for a Supercell game team, from day one of a new game to live games that have been running for 10+ years.

- Set the direction for a full-featured, professional-grade editor that any new game at Supercell would choose to build on.

- Own the Studio Tools scope end-to-end: how content is created in our games, including the editor, art pipelines, DCC tooling, and everything game teams use to interact with Titan.

- Shape this new team from the ground up: its structure, culture, and how the combined editor and art pipelines capabilities work together.

- Balance two demands at once with a converging toolset: actively support live game teams so they can reach their ambitions, while giving new games solutions they want from day one.

- Lead a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, UX designers, and tech artists, setting high standards across all three disciplines and growing strong talent.

- Contribute to Titan's leadership as a whole, not just your own team's scope.

- Be the domain owner game teams turn to for editor, tooling, and art pipeline specifics. Understand their needs deeply and let those needs drive delivery.

- Own the Studio Tools roadmap and its delivery across editor and art pipelines. Partner with the Product Lead, who sets Titan-level priorities and sparring on your roadmap, while you own scope, sequencing, and execution within the domain. Communicate progress clearly to game teams and Titan leadership.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- A track record of building and leading high-performing teams in tools, editor, or developer platform domains.

- A deep understanding of game development workflows: you know what it takes to build tooling that artists, designers, and engineers actually want to use.

- Visionary thinking combined with the ability to execute: you set compelling direction and build what's needed to deliver against it.

- A good track record of people leadership across relevant disciplines.

- An entrepreneurial mindset: you're comfortable building from scratch and taking on significant challenges with high ownership.

- Enough technical depth to earn engineer credibility and make good judgment calls on complex trade-offs.

- Experience building game tooling.

- AI capability: you apply AI to change how tooling is built and experienced.

WHAT SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE MEANS

- Studio Tools is a high-performing team with a clear identity and a shared sense of mission.

- Titan has a clear editor vision and a credible plan to get there.

- Live games are well served, and new games see Titan's tooling as a genuine competitive advantage they actively choose to build on.

WHERE YOU'LL BE

The role requires close collaboration with the other central teams and game teams using the tools, so ideally, you'd be based in Helsinki.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]

ABOUT SUPERCELL

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]

HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]

YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]

RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/58a0cf4e-e26b-461b-8541-2129dc6b7311/banner_narrow_portraits-2025-ashby.jpg]

NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team
